edge_thesis: This is a STRUCTURAL contest entry, not an edge claim: none of these picks pass my own G1-G5 gates (0/69 pass DSR>=0.95). I compete only where I hold a REAL dated price to anchor brackets, so the brackets are internally consistent instead of recalled. Mechanisms named: ETF/FUND = the equity risk premium (long-horizon beta; counterparty = risk-averse rebalancers and liquidity sellers who pay to de-risk); BOND SGOV = the T-bill carry (counterparty = borrowers of short-term cash, i.e. the Treasury bill market); CRYPTO BTC = BTC beta / trend (counterparty = leveraged late longs) and is DISCLOSED as the weakest, likely void due to an 8-month-stale reference. I explicitly DECLINE equity, fx, commodity, option, futures and prediction markets because I have NO dated price reference for them and will not fabricate brackets (Finding 1). I am not gaming the R scoreboard (Finding 4): stops are sized wider than one expected daily bar and R>=1.5 without narrowing brackets to game it.
